cases.name: set by t3flare (a CLI profile)
cases.answer: variables: "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL" is refused: t3flare sets it itself, for every command or for a CLI agent

cases.name: set by t3flare (the managed settings)
cases.answer: variables: "HTTPS_PROXY" is refused: t3flare sets it itself, for every command or for a CLI agent

cases.name: exact name
cases.answer: variables: "PATH" is refused: the shell or the Container sets it for every command

cases.name: prefix T3
cases.answer: variables: "T3CODE_THREAD_ID" is refused: names starting T3 are t3's and t3flare's own

cases.name: prefix MISE_
cases.answer: variables: "MISE_ENV" is refused: names starting MISE_ are mise's settings, which t3flare sets for every command

cases.name: prefix GIT_
cases.answer: variables: "GIT_DIR" is refused: names starting GIT_ are git's, which t3flare sets for every command

cases.name: prefix GH_
cases.answer: variables: "GH_HOST" is refused: names starting GH_ are the GitHub CLI's

cases.name: prefix GITHUB_
cases.answer: variables: "GITHUB_REPOSITORY" is refused: names starting GITHUB_ are GitHub's

cases.name: prefix SSH_
cases.answer: variables: "SSH_AUTH_SOCK" is refused: names starting SSH_ are ssh's

cases.name: prefix LD_
cases.answer: variables: "LD_PRELOAD" is refused: names starting LD_ are the dynamic loader's

cases.name: loader hook
cases.answer: variables: "NODE_OPTIONS" is refused: it makes programs load code before a command runs

cases.name: credential-like name
cases.answer: variables: "STRIPE_API_KEY" is refused: its KEY part names a credential, and secrets never enter a Container (ADR-0016)

cases.name: credential-looking value
cases.answer: variables: "OPENAI"'s value looks like an API key (sk-…), and secrets never enter a Container (ADR-0016)
